title: Login service discovery document, contract v1 (DRAFT v1-d2)
description: GET /.well-known/openid-configuration. Labels per contract/README.md. Fields and fixed values: [SRC: PLAN §3.1 L106]. Listener: front [TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-1]; also on 8084 [DOC SILENT -> OQ-31].

issuer.description: Real: https://login.<domain>/ [SRC: LD §4.5 L211]. Stand-in: path contains /standin [SRC: PLAN §3.5].

token_endpoint.description: Served on back channel 8084 [SRC: PLAN L109]. URL written under the public issuer; clients call their configured back-channel base URL [SSE Proposal -> OQ-3].

revocation_endpoint.description: Served on back channel 8084 [SRC: PLAN L110]. URL under the public issuer [SSE Proposal -> OQ-3].

jwks_uri.description: Path /.well-known/jwks on the front listener [SRC: PLAN L107; TL Decision 2026-11-02, OQ-1].

subject_types_supported.description: Required by OIDC Discovery 1.0 §3; not in PLAN [ASSUME A-2 -> OQ-4].

token_endpoint_auth_signing_alg_values_s.description: For private_key_jwt. Value not stated anywhere [ASSUME A-27 -> OQ-21].

revocation_endpoint_auth_methods_support.description: Same as the token endpoint [ASSUME A-27 -> OQ-21].

not.description: Not in v1: userinfo [SRC: PLAN L123]; front/back-channel logout [SRC: PLAN §1.3 L60]; introspection not published [ASSUME A-3 -> OQ-4].

$comment: additionalProperties stays true so the real OpenIddict service can publish extra standard fields; clients may rely only on the fields named above (PLAN §3.1 L100). Whether the stand-in must publish exactly this set: OQ-4.
